Advanced OCR Pipeline is planned for general release in August 2026 (v2.8.0, target date August 25, 2026) as a standard component of the KnowledgeHub ingestion layer [NL-014#NL-014-S03][NL-014#NL-014-S06]. Its planned availability is plan-dependent: it is included natively in the Enterprise plan, offered as a paid add-on for Growth plans ($500/month), and not supported on the Starter plan [NL-014#NL-014-S06].

WorkflowCoach public beta is officially targeted for September 2026 (v2.9.0, target date September 29, 2026), available to all active Growth and Enterprise accounts [NL-014#NL-014-S05][NL-014#NL-014-S03]. However, internal engineering estimates indicate the public beta may slip to November 2026 due to permission-check and dependency concerns [NL-015#NL-015-S05][NL-014#NL-014-S05].

Teams connector is still under active design and is planned for Q4 2026 (v2.11.0, November release), with a restricted pilot beginning in October 2026 for selected financial and healthcare enterprise accounts [NL-014#NL-014-S07]. Only the Slack connector is currently available as a limited pilot [NL-014#NL-014-S07].

In contrast, OCR has a firmer August target with plan-level restrictions; WorkflowCoach public beta is officially September but has a November contingency; and the Teams connector is planned later in Q4/November with a pilot-first approach.
